about: CF-247, 19 Oct 2026 (Platform Admin 20:33: "refresh plan for evidence, plan and execute the next steps"): files in the evidence bucket that no record uses: course-page files (layer2/<country>/coverage), adapter-builder captures whose draft is gone (layer2/<country>/adapters), and scholarship page files (layer2/<country>/scholarships), saved before 19 Oct 2026 and named by none of the 19 file-path columns, the register replay path lists or the dedupe log. Exported (the Storage records, not the files) before the paste file lists them for removal; the paste file refuses to run unless each set's count and key hash still match.

sets.name: orphan_course_page_files
sets.select: select o.id, o.bucket_id, o.name, o.metadata, o.created_at from storage.objects o where o.bucket_id = 'evidence' and o.created_at < timestamptz '2026-10-19 00:00:00+00' and split_part(o.name, '/', 1) = 'layer2' and split_part(o.name, '/', 3) = 'coverage' and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.evidence_artifacts x where x.storage_path = o.name) and not exists (select 1
